message.content:
A medium‑sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 kcal**.  
If you’re looking at smaller cherry tomatoes, they’re about 5–7 kcal each, while larger beefsteak tomatoes can reach 30–35 kcal.  

So, for most everyday uses, you can round to about **20–25 kcal per medium tomato**.
